text:
abby: noticed 9 trials in 'onboard_wait' that never hit the reassignment playbook after the midnight import. they were lingered >10h.

leo: i see those IDs  queue shows worker dropouts between 00:05-00:25 UTC. brief autoscaler hiccup.

abby: logs show `lock_acquire_failed -> skipping reassign` but no fallback event. that's new.

corey: looks like we tightened the lock TTL last week. if the lock fails fast we swallow the fallback path. quick fix: emit a compact event `reassign_pending` to low-priority topic when lock_acquire_failed. consumer will dedupe by run_id.

leo: +1. also add a console flag so CS can search `reassign_pending` and manually trigger rescinds.

abby: can we get an emergency export of the 9 accounts for manual nudges? renewal team is on standby.

ops-bot: export generated: CS-EX-78991.csv attached to ticket #CS-5022

corey: i'll push a tiny hotfix to runner to emit the event and add unit tests for dedupe. will also add metric `reassign_pending_count`.

leo: i'll create an alert: if `onboard_wait_count > 5` for 1h, notify #csops-urgent.

abby: thanks. once hotfix is up we'll replay the reassign_pending queue and confirm the 9 accounts moved to owners. then retro next week.
